Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your global channels and campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I am hands-on with analytics tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEMrush, and I have experience with social media integration. My project mirook.com showcases my ability to implement structured data and optimize for AI-driven search, demonstrating my tech-savvy and analytical mindset.

I am detail-oriented, structured, and comfortable managing multiple tasks. I am eager to bring my skills in content management, analytics, and social media coordination to your team, and to grow within an international environment. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I am fluent in English, with Dutch at B1 level.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Wolf Oil Corporation. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content management, I am drawn to the hands-on, full-spectrum nature of this role—from website updates and marketing automation to social media coordination and analytics.

In my current role at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to your needs. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, conduct keyword research, and publish keyword-targeted content that improves organic visibility. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring content is accurate and aligned with digital strategy. I regularly use Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and guide decisions—skills that would support your data, reporting, and quality monitoring responsibilities.

My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to manage a complete digital presence: I designed and built the site, integrated social media, and implemented structured data (JSON-LD) and llms.txt to enhance visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project reflects my curiosity and drive to improve efficiency, qualities I see valued at Wolf Oil Corporation.

I am detail-oriented, structured, and comfortable collaborating with teams and agencies. I am also supportive in guiding colleagues in digital tools, as I have done informally at Episto. Based in Zwijndrecht, I am fluent in English and have Dutch at B1 level, with ongoing classes.

I am eager to bring my technical and creative skills to your international team and contribute to keeping your global channels accurate, consistent, and high-performing. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
